newsitem.title: USA: Blair says 1996 Q4, year sales overstated.
newsitem.headline: Blair says 1996 Q4, year sales overstated.

text.p: Blair Corp on Monday said it had overstated its 1996 fourth-quarter and full-year sales results by $5 million when it released the results on February 5.
The restatement puts the company's fourth-quarter sales at $152,376,000, down from the $157,376,000 it stated February 5. In the year-ago quarter, the company had sales of $157,644,000.
The restatement also brings the company's full-year sales down to $544,129,000 from the $549,129,000 it stated February 5. The company had sales of $560,890,000 in 1995.
